example_sentences_in_english: This saree is as fine as nayan sukho muslin.
The old Dhaka muslin was renowned as a delight to the eyes.
history: Refers to the famous Dhaka muslin, a fine cotton fabric produced in Bengal during the Mughal era, known for its delicacy and translucency that pleased the eyes.
note: Originated from the textile trade in historical Bengal.
